newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Winterthur streamlines big company cover.
newsitem.headline: Winterthur streamlines big company cover.

text.p: Insurer Winterthur Group said it was reorganising its international coverage for big corporate customers as one streamlined business area.
Under the plan, the International Division that takes care of multinational corporate business will be renamed Winterthur International.

"Its legal structure will be simplified and one unit will specialise in developing new kinds of solutions for alternative risk transfers (ART) to meet the needs of large multinational companies," Winterthur said in a statement.
The existing International Division generated a gross premium volume of 2.1 billion Swiss francs in 1996 and is one of the leading international industrial insurers.
Winterthur said the International Division had until now written its business through the parent company, the parent's branch offices and subsidiaries in various countries.
Under the new plan, Winterthur International will be created and based in Britain as an insurance carrier for the European Union, excluding Germany.

"Winterthur will benefit from the freedom to provide services in the EU and will thus be able to conduct its mutinational corporate business more professionally and more cost-efficiently while focusing more sharply on its customers," the company said.
In Germany, Winterthur International will be established as a subsidiary of DBV-Winterthur Holding.
In the rest of the world and Switzerland, the present risk carriers will continue to act as such, Winterthur said.
The speciality unit for alternative risk transfers will offer insurance solutions to customers from the 1,000 biggest worldwide companies.
"This will be carried out in cooperation with RFC (Reinsurance Finance Consultants), the joint venture of CS Holding, Swiss Re and the Winterthur Group," it said.

Winterthur International will also create centres of expertise for its staff covering the pharmaceuticals, chemicals, motor, machinery and metals sectors in order to foster industry-specific solution.
